allowed_operations: post the existing expert run command

ticket_control_plane.purpose: Authorize issue state and enforce duplicate-task protection before computation.

invariants: The three business centers are peers and never call, dispatch, import, read runtime artifacts from, or write runtime artifacts to each other.
GPTs remains the business orchestrator; the governance repository is only its command and status gateway.
The governance gateway may create formal child Issues but may not execute or alter business-center work.

An API result becomes compute input only after GPTs retrieves and verifies the complete snapshot, manifest and hashes, creates an independent relay attestation, and then creates a new governance control ticket.
A compute result becomes expert evidence only after GPTs retrieves and verifies the complete result package, then creates a new governance control ticket.
The numerical compute runtime never fetches business data, calls models, downloads code or contacts another center.
No center may silently repair another center's data, assumptions, prompts, code, workflow or output.
Installed but disabled integrations have no runtime authority.

compute_material_handoff.authoritative_source_storage: private Hugging Face Dataset managed by Evidence Center
compute_material_handoff.output: self-contained immutable GitHub Actions Artifact awaiting an independent GPTs relay attestation
trust_stages: GPTs approves the selected verified source records and canonical selection SHA256 before packaging
Evidence Center packager verifies source bytes and produces manifest, envelope, payload and content SHA256
GPTs retrieves the complete Artifact bytes and independently verifies manifest, envelope, payload and content SHA256
GPTs adds gpts-relay-attestation.json bound to the task, transfer, manifest, envelope and content hashes
Compute Center independently revalidates all bytes and both GPTs trust stages before numeric execution
gpts_responsibilities: bind the selection to a task ID and canonical selection SHA256
retrieve the complete package bytes rather than metadata only
verify the Evidence Center receipt, manifest SHA256, envelope SHA256 and content SHA256
create an independent gpts-relay-attestation.json after package verification
bind the relay attestation to the same task ID, transfer ID, manifest SHA256, envelope SHA256 and content SHA256
relay the complete package and attestation without modifying the Evidence Center bytes
create a separate governance compute ticket
compute_responsibilities: receive complete package bytes and the independent GPTs relay attestation through GPTs
run offline deep validation before numeric execution
recalculate manifest, envelope and payload SHA256 values
verify validity dates, source review dates, license use scope and source-record bindings
verify GPTs selection approval is PASS and bound to the same task and selection
verify GPTs relay attestation is PASS and bound to the same task, transfer, manifest, envelope and content hashes
reject credentials, unsafe paths, symbolic links, undeclared files, archives and executable content
prohibited: Evidence Center claiming that GPTs approved the final manifest
Evidence Center creating the GPTs relay attestation
Evidence Center dispatching or uploading directly to Compute Center
Compute Center downloading Evidence Center or Hugging Face artifacts
governance repository storing or downloading business package bytes
artifact ID, URL or digest being treated as package content
